title: Roadmap Roundup - June 4, 2025
summary: 06/04/2025 - 6:00 PM Roadmap Roundup Hello everyone!
body_html:
06/04/2025 - 6:00 PM Roadmap Roundup Hello everyone!

Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.

Just a reminder: The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.

Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.

With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!

-CIG Community Team

Notable Changes: June 4, 2025

Release View

4.2.0

Irradiated Apex Valakkar

Adding the irradiated Apex Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

The card has been set to Committed.

Irradiated Adult Valakkar

Adding the irradiated Adult Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

The card has been set to Committed.

Irradiated Juvenile Valakkar

Adding the irradiated Juvenile Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

The card has been set to Committed.

Irradiated Kopion

Adding the irradiated Kopion that players can find roaming near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card. These hostile beasts hunt in packs!

The card has been set to Committed.

New Hairstyles (4.2.0)

Adding four additional hairstyles.

The card has been set to Committed.

Radiation

Implementing dangerous radiation zones in specific locations, forcing players to adapt with specialized gear and strategic navigation.

The card has been set to Committed.

ASD Research Facility

Strategically located on Pyro I, Associated Science and Development facilities that provided essential infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

The card has been set to Committed.

ASD Datacenter

Strategically placed on Pyro IV, Associated Science and Development datacenters are providing key infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

The card has been set to Committed.

Storm Breaker Sandbox Activity

Adding the Storm Breaker Sandbox activity, utilizing new gameplay mechanics to tell new stories in the 'verse.

The card has been set to Committed.

ARGO ATLS IKTI

Adding the ATLS IKTI, and ATLS GEO IKTI: versatile new combat suits developed for upcoming challenges, ready to prove their value in an upcoming new Sandbox Activity. They both are equipped with dual weapons, and the GEO IKTI version keeps its backpack for a jumping ability with adjusted gear slots to fit FPS weapons and gadgets.

The card has been set to Committed.

Wikelo Special Ships (4.2.0)

Adding multiple new ships and vehicles to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: Mirai Guardian QI, Anvil Mk2 Super Hornet, MISC Fortune, Aopoa Nox, Mirai Pulse, RSI Ursa Medivac. These ships and vehicles can be unlocked by bringing the NPC Wikelo a number of favors in exchange for rewards.

The card has been set to Committed.

VOLT Laser Shotgun "Prism"

Adding a cutting-edge energy shotgun that ramps up its pellet spread with heat, delivering brutal close-range bursts powered by VOLT.

The card has been set to Committed.

Sterling Exploration Suit

Introducing the Sterling Exploration Suit: a heavy utility armor built to withstand extreme radiation, enabling safe traversal through the most hazardous zones.

The card has been set to Committed.

Dynamic Rain

Adding dynamic rain in specific locations, as a first step toward Genesis: Dynamic Weather.

The card has been set to Committed.

Aegis Idris-P

Adding the Idris Peacekeeper. A ship that secured our past and continues to define our future, this steadfast, tactical, civilian class incarnation of the UEEN darling is available to fly for the first time.

The card has been set to Released.

Greycat MTC

Adding the MTC vehicle, Greycat's comprehensive suit and gun storage, defensive weaponry, and its customary off-road ability.

The card has been set to Released.

Mirai Guardian MX

Adding the Mirai Guardian MX. Keeping the cutting-edge design of its predecessor, the MX refines destruction to a powerful art. Enhanced weaponry and shields mean Mirai, once again, has put you ahead of every other single pilot flying.

The card has been set to Released.

MISC Starlancer TAC

Adding the Starlancer TAC ship, designed for tactical assault and rescue.

The card has been set to Released.

Anvil Asgard

Introducing Anvil’s new savior of the battlefield, the Asgard - a heavily armored vehicle-dropship equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones.

The card has been set to Released.

Join the discussion on Spectrum.

title: This Week in Star Citizen
summary: 05/26/2025 - 8:00 PM This Week in Star Citizen Happy Monday, everyone!
body_html:
05/26/2025 - 8:00 PM This Week in Star Citizen Happy Monday, everyone!

There’s still time to swing by the Bevic Convention Center and take a few ships for a spin before Invictus Launch Week draws to a close. Whether you’re jumping in for the first time or taking another lap, now’s the perfect moment to enjoy the Free Fly and test some of the ‘verse’s best military-inspired ships before it ends on May 27. We’ve also really enjoyed seeing you share your experiences of the big event on the Community Hub, so keep those coming!

After Invictus Launch Week wraps up, we’ll begin rolling out ship naming waves for the Aegis Idris, starting with original concept owners and Golden Ticket holders. If that’s you, you can find the details in this Spectrum post. More waves will follow soon after.

Meanwhile, work continues on Alpha 4.2, with our teams iterating on early feedback from the Evocati. This update will include dynamic rain, improved kiosk interactions, new hairstyles, and more — and we're aiming to open up for broader testing soon.

Lastly, the Bar Citizen World Tour continues! This Saturday, May 31, we visit the heart of one of Europe's most vibrant cities: Lyon, France. If you're in the area, come meet the team, raise a glass, and celebrate all things Star Citizen with fellow enthusiasts. Check out our World Tour comm-link for more details on this event (and other upcoming ones).

Now, let's see what's going on this week

This Tuesday, keep an eye out for the May Squadron 42 Newsletter, because the ships of Squadron 42 are ready for their close-up! Make sure you're subscribed so you don't miss a frame.

Friday, you'll find a copy of the weekly RSI Newsletter delivered straight to your inbox.

On Saturday, it's time for the System 7 Finals by ATMO esports! After weeks of blistering speed, tight turns, and challenging race tracks, the best of the best are set to battle it out for glory. Tune in to ATMO esports' channel from 6 pm UTC to see who will emerge victorious.

Fly low, and fly fast!

body_html:
May Newsletter BEHIND THE BADGE

Although much is known of the accolades of our proud 42nd Squadron, inside intel of these history-making achievements has been for military eyes only - until now. The 42nd Squadron made their mark during the Battle for Centauri, a standoff which ultimately concluded the second Tevarin war, when, under the leadership of Captain Alexandra Dunlevy, they feigned retreat in order to form an ambush of the Tevarin fleet.

This tactical maneuver undoubtedly led to the UEEN’s victory and is still studied by new recruits and military personnel to this day. Join us, as Invictus 2955 comes to an end, in celebrating not only our serving fleet, but also commemorating the ships, crew and lives of some of the UEEN’s finest, the 42nd Squadron.

Building off a career that's sprawled over thirty years, Declan's worked on every fighter in the fleet to become a walking encyclopedia of parts, weapons, engines, and armor. As more and more mechanics turned to him for his expansive knowledge, he grew into a natural position of authority, eventually earning Chief Petty Officer and assuming the celebrated role of Krugeri Pit Chief. He may love nothing more than the thrum of a busy flight deck, but will always make time for his crew and flight officers alike to talk about the simple joys of flying.

title: Roadmap Roundup - May 21, 2025
summary: 05/21/2025 - 9:00 PM Roadmap Roundup Hello everyone!
body_html:
05/21/2025 - 9:00 PM Roadmap Roundup Hello everyone!

Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.

Just a reminder: The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.

Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.

Note: REDACTED cards are purposefully hiding details, to avoid spoiling content for players. As we have now started our test cycle with the Evocati, you will learn more as we progress through the development of 4.2.0 and beyond.

With that, let’s dive into this week’s Roadmap Roundup!

-CIG Community Team

Notable Changes: May 21, 2025

Release View

4.1

Missions - Local Site Maintenance

Implementing new missions into the persistent universe, first appearing in Pyro's outposts. Players will be tasked with going to the location and fixing equipment with fuses and repairing pipes (RMC Repair) with your multi-tool.

The card has been set to Released.

Missions - Animal Population Control

Enabling animal population control Missions.

The card has been set to Released.

Mission - Hunt The Polaris

Adding a new Fleet Week mission. A Polaris has been stolen by the Frontier Fighters, and the CDF is tasked by the UEE Navy to hunt it through the Stanton system, isolate it, and kill it. The mission will be offered rarely, can be shared, and will only have one active at a time. Once completed, a reward will be given.

The card has been set to Released.

New Hairstyles (4.1.1)

Adding four additional hairstyles with Update 4.1.1.

The card has been set to Released.

VOLT SMG "Quartz"

Adding a compact, yet devastating firearm designed for those who need maximum firepower in a minimal frame.

The card has been set to Released.

Components Balance Pass

Balancing ship components and shield generators based on their class types.

The card has been set to Released.

Wikelo Special Ships (4.1.1)

Adding the following Special Ships to Wikelo's Emporium: MISC Starlancer MAX, Aegis Sabre Firebird, Aegis Sabre Peregrine, RSI Zeus ES, RSI Zeus CL, Crusader Intrepid, with top-grade components (Currently Stock modules. It will be fixed in 4.2.0). These ships can be unlocked by bringing the NPC Wikelo a number of favors in exchange of rewards.

The card has been set to Released.

Space Combat Missions: UEE Training, Patrol, Ambush

Adding new missions to the 'verse.

These cards have been set to Released.

New column, 4.2.0

New Creatures

Adding multiple new creatures to the 'verse.

The card has been set to Tentative.

New Hairstyles (4.2.0)

Adding four additional hairstyles with Update 4.2.0

The card has been set to Tentative.

Radiation

Implementing dangerous radiation zones in specific locations, forcing players to adapt with specialized gear and strategic navigation.

The card has been set to Tentative.

ASD Research Facility

Strategically located on Pyro I, Associated Science and Development facilities that provided essential infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

The card has been set to Tentative.

ASD Datacenter

Strategically placed on Pyro IV, Associated Science and Development datacenters are providing key infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

The card has been set to Tentative.

Sandbox Activity

Adding a Sandbox activity utilizing new gameplay mechanics, and vehicles to tell new stories in the 'verse.

The card has been set to Tentative.

ARGO ATLS IKTI

Adding the ARGO ATLS IKTI is a versatile new combat vehicle developed for upcoming challenges, ready to prove its value in an upcoming new Sandbox Activity.

The card has been set to Tentative.

Wikelo Special Ships (4.2.0)

Adding multiple new ships and vehicles to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium. These ships and vehicles can be unlocked by bringing the NPC Wikelo a number of favors in exchange for rewards.

The card has been set to Tentative.

VOLT Laser Shotgun "Prism"

Adding a cutting-edge energy shotgun that ramps up its pellet spread with heat, delivering brutal close-range bursts powered by VOLT.

The card has been set to Tentative.

Sterling Exploration Suit

Introducing the Sterling Exploration Suit: a heavy utility armor built to withstand extreme radiation, enabling safe traversal through the most hazardous zones.

The card has been set to Tentative.

Dynamic Rain

Adding dynamic rain in specific locations, as a first step toward Genesis: Dynamic Weather.

The card has been set to Tentative.

New Global Event (4.2.x)

Adding a global, cross-shard event that builds on collaboration and competition. Scheduled to come in a 4.2.x patch.

The card has been set to Tentative.

New Space Combat Mission - Defend (4.2.x)

Adding a collection of missions tasking citizens to defend various places against attackers. Scheduled to come in a 4.2.x patch.

The card has been set to Tentative.

New Medium Utility armor (4.2.x)

Adding a new legendary Medium Utility armor. Scheduled to come in a 4.2.x patch.

The card has been set to Tentative.

Progress Tracker

We've made a few additions to the Progress Tracker, which you can review below. Just a reminder: when progress on a deliverable is marked as complete, it doesn’t necessarily mean it’s ready for release. It may still require downstream support, transition to another team for further work, or other additional steps before completion.

title: This Week in Star Citizen
summary: 05/19/2025 - 10:00 PM This Week in Star Citizen Happy Monday, everyone!
body_html:
05/19/2025 - 10:00 PM This Week in Star Citizen Happy Monday, everyone!

Invictus Launch Week 2955 has officially touched down at Bevic Convention Center on ArcCorp! This annual event honors the legacy of the UEE Navy while giving everyone the chance to experience the ships and technology that defend the Empire. Don't miss the chance to test fly the best military-inspired ships with our Free Fly event, running from now through May 27. Plus, there are activities galore for pilots from all walks of life, offering something for everyone throughout Invictus Launch Week.

This year brings a special highlight - the Aegis Idris. Not only is it available to tour at the Aegis Idris Experience, but we’re also pleased to see this iconic capital ship take its place in the hangars and skies of the ‘verse, letting owners command one of the Navy’s most formidable vessels. To help you make the most of your time at Invictus, we've prepared a detailed FAQ covering everything you need to know about the big event (including Free Fly access, ship rentals, and more), and the Manufacturer Schedule to help you plan your test flights. As always, we look forward to seeing you share your favorite moments, ship impressions, and screenshots on the Community Hub, whether this is your first event or if you're an Invictus veteran.

Last Saturday, CON42 lit up the Bar Citizen World Tour with nearly 600 attendees coming together near Frankfurt for a weekend full of Star Citizen excitement. From incredible fan-built ship models to hands-on activities and thoughtful conversations, the event was packed with energy and shared passion. A massive thanks to the amazing organizers and everyone who joined us; it was one for the books! Next up: Lyon, France on May 31. More details on upcoming events here.

And finally, the team is full steam ahead as we prepare to release Alpha 4.2.0 to our Evocati testers this week — potentially as early as tonight! We’ll keep you posted as things progress, and we can’t wait for you to experience the new content coming your way soon.

Now, let's see what's going on this week

On Monday, Behind the Ships kicks off the week with a closer look at another ship making its debut this Invictus Launch Week - the Mirai Guardian MX, a heavy-hitting variant of the Guardian built to bring more bite to the fight. We'll also be publishing the Mirai Guardian MX Q&A.

This Tuesday, our servers will be offline for approximately 4 hours starting from 13:00 UTC / 8:00 AM CDT to accommodate essential infrastructure tuning on our backend systems and the implementation of stability upgrades. During this maintenance window, all gameplay systems will be unavailable; you will not be able to access the game until maintenance is complete. We will provide updates on the RSI Status Page as the maintenance progresses. Thanks for your patience as we carry out this work. We'll have the 'verse back up and running as soon as possible!

Wednesday will have the latest Roadmap Update alongside an explanatory Roadmap Roundup.

Friday, we close out with another Behind the Ships episode, this time featuring the Anvil Asgard, which will be accompanied by a Q&A Comm-Link. You'll also find a copy of the weekly RSI Newsletter delivered straight to your inbox.

This Saturday, Race 6, the last race before the System 7 finals, touches down in the tropical chaos of "Bermuda Bay", a track ATMO esports has cooked up featuring a brutal blend of speed and precision. Watch the 'verse's best pilots thread razor-thin island gaps and blast through breakneck straights in their Aopoa Noxes live on the ATMO esports' channel from 7 pm UTC.

Fly low, and fly fast!

title: Q&A: Anvil Asgard
summary: Q&A Asgard by Anvil Introducing Anvil’s new savior of the battlefield, the Asgard - a heavily armored vehicle equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones.
body_html:
Q&A Asgard by Anvil Introducing Anvil’s new savior of the battlefield, the Asgard - a heavily armored vehicle equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones.

We asked the Vehicle and Gameplay teams a few questions about Anvil's new dropship. Here are the answers, straight from the devs themselves.

What is the key difference between the Valkyrie and the Asgard? In what situations might a player choose one over the other? The primary difference is that the Asgard chassis has been extended to accommodate the on-board storage of a single Nova-tank-sized vehicle or one of the Anvil Atlas chassis family (Ballista, Spartan, and Centurion).

However, this is at the expense of crew accommodation and drop seats, which the Valkyrie houses. The crew requirement for the Asgard is lower than the Valkyrie, as some weapons are slaved to the pilot, allowing for significant forward-facing firepower. In comparison, the Valkyrie’s turrets provide greater coverage in all arcs beyond the front.

How many people can be accommodated in the Asgard dropship? How many when a Nova Tank is loaded? There are no dedicated drop seats in the Asgard. The crew requirement is only two players, these being a pilot and a second player either operating the manual lower turret or completing engineering-related work.

If the Asgard pilot is alone and without a gunner, how many forward-facing weapons can they operate? The pilot can control the six facing-forward S3 weapons along with the top-mounted missile rack.

Are the 2x S4 manual gunner turrets able to fire in an arc, or are they fixed to face forward? The manual gunner turrets can rotate 360 degrees with good downward-facing angles, allowing players to engage ground targets ahead of dropping vehicles into the area.

The Asgard has a significant amount of facing-forward weaponry, rather than multiple turrets covering all angles of defense as found on other dropships. What was the reasoning behind this design choice? We wanted there to be gameplay differences between the Asgard and other dropships, like the Valkyrie. It was a conscious design decision to provide most of the firepower as forward-facing to distinguish the Asgard amongst those other ships.

What was the reasoning behind equipping the Asgard with 16x S3 missiles? What threats or targets is it specifically designed to counter? The missiles were added to provide some ability to tackle threats outside of the front arc. However, missile lock is only possible from the pilot’s view, requiring players to keep targets in sight prior to launch.

Can you provide examples of missions, roles, or scenarios that the Asgard is intended for? The Asgard excels in missions that require transporting ground vehicles and cargo, either together or independently. With its large rear ramp, loading and unloading cargo is simple.

Does the Asgard feature a cargo grid in addition to its 180 SCU storage? Could this be used to transport ammo, fuel, and other equipment to the battlefield? The 180 SCU cargo grid is the only cargo grid on the vehicle and occupies the same area as the vehicle storage. This means that when a vehicle is aboard, cargo capacity is reduced.

Does the Asgard retain the lateral doors from its sister ship, the Valkyrie? Yes, along with the side door guns.

Does the pilot have good visibility beneath them to aid in landing troops? Is there an MFD landing camera system? We are still working on updated landing systems that utilize the radar displays to show the location of the ship relative to its surrounding terrain.

Can the four thrusters on the Asgard transition to VTOL mode? Yes, they can.

Is it possible to apply Valkyrie paints to the Asgard? No, the Asgard is treated as a new and separate vehicle, so paints from the Valkyrie are not applicable to the Asgard.

DISCLAIMER These answers accurately reflect development's intentions at the time of writing, but the company and development team reserve the right to adapt, improve, or change feature and ship designs in response to feedback, playtesting, design revisions, or other considerations to improve balance or the quality of the game overall.
